Parties.description: List the legal names of the contracting parties and their roles. Use only information in the contract.

EffectiveDate.description: Return the date the contract takes effect. Distinguish it from signature dates. Return null if the effective date cannot be determined from the contract.

TerminationNoticeDays.description: Return the number of calendar days of notice required for termination without cause. Return null if the contract does not specify one unambiguous calendar-day notice period.

RenewalSummary.description: Summarize the renewal terms, including whether renewal is automatic, the renewal period, and any notice deadline. If renewal terms are not stated, say so.

ObligationsSummary.description: Summarize each party's main obligations, combining relevant clauses across the contract. Include stated deadlines and conditions. Do not infer obligations that are not stated.
